correctness.rationale: The 16 spanning trees form a five-dimensional matroid base polytope. Edmonds rank inequalities exhaust its supporting halfspaces; exact testing of all 62 nontrivial proper subsets yields 16 distinct facets. All 219 faces are then enumerated as nonempty intersections of facets, and each normal cone is tested by primitive rays and integral maximal-minor gcd. There are exactly 94 singular faces and 30 inclusion-maximal ones, 24 unimodular triangular 2-faces and six primitive parallelograms. Each maximal singular normal cone has four rays with all triples primitive and unique balanced relation, hence transverse ad-bc=0. Exact packaged checker executed and passed. No inference from a finite sample to a larger infinite family.

value.rationale: M(K4) is a canonical first nontrivial graphic matroid in Grassmannian torus-orbit geometry and Bergman combinatorics. Its normal projective toric fivefold has complete nontrivial stratification into 24 planes and 6 Segre surfaces with all generic germs conifold, and 94 singular orbits. This resolves the full singular/non-Q-factorial geometry of a natural fixed variety and gives exact finite classification rather than an arbitrary slice or already-known textbook deduction.
